dwde-2020-plots.title: Deep Water Dispersion Experiment, RAFOS Component, Final Report, July 2020
dwde-2020-plots.access: Original WHOI-hosted report; native unmodified properties-panel rasters and page 51 methods visually reviewed. Values estimated from the published graphs, not printed numeric observations.

records.source_locator: Figure 3-25(e), printed page 48 / PDF page 53; definition in Figure 3-25 caption and section 3.9.
records.definition: Mean distance from the centroid to the maximum-circulation contour; estimated envelope of one labeled plotted trace. This is not an area-equivalent or maximum-speed radius.
records.scope: Nautilus / A1 child; blue curve only.
records.qualification: Graph-read estimate for a named published case; physical catalogue crosswalk remains unverified. Range covers the selected plotted trace only, not a seasonal envelope, confidence interval or full lifetime extrema. A 5 km graph-reading allowance is applied before rounding both ends outward to 10 km. Measurement uncertainty in the original product is unspecified. This is a separately labeled child/merger case, not a dimension assigned to the intact original ring; child traces are not pooled.
records.period_label: Selected curve segment, approximately days 1-104 on the source time-since-detachment axis
